name: tpl-existence-2-goal
task: Open the door and pick up the box in the other room.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: the task commands two events — opening the door and picking up the box in the other room — and the two hard Existence clauses (door_open, target_picked_up) require each one, giving a nonempty FINAL_STATES. No order wording appears in the task ('and' is not 'before'), so no Precedence is required; the environment's own constraints (target_picked_up cannot become true before door_open) already guarantee the sequencing without any added clause, and adding one would be an added requirement.

texts: Open the door at least once.
Pick up the box in the other room at least once.
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1, u2, u3
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES: u3
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, !door_open&target_picked_up) -> u1
(u0, door_open&!target_picked_up) -> u2
(u0, door_open&target_picked_up) -> u3
(u1, door_open) -> u3
(u2, target_picked_up) -> u3
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, !door_open&target_picked_up, u1) -> 1
(u0, door_open&!target_picked_up, u2) -> 1
(u0, door_open&target_picked_up, u3) -> 12
(u1, door_open, u3) -> 11
(u2, target_picked_up, u3) -> 11
